in_marathi.name: Vishnuvardhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishnuvardhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishnu is the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti, the holy trinity of Hinduism, preserving the universe from evil. Vardhan means 'nourisher' or 'provider'. Vishnuvardhan is the nourisher of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Vishnuvardhan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Protector of the universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vishnuvardhan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vishnu is the preserver in the Hindu Trimurti, the holy trinity of Hinduism, preserving the universe from evil. Vardhan means 'nourisher' or 'provider'. Vishnuvardhan is the nourisher of the universe.
